packet_dag.terminal_condition: The super-ramble is controlled when each child packet has a clear scope, unsafe external writes are blocked, and the first performance/current-state audit packet is ready.

title: One Time Performance, Media, And Classroom Workflow Control Tower

reasons: The operator reported severe app lag and button-click delay.
The request spans member library filters, Vimeo/Drive automation, slides, worksheets, security, auth UX, comments, updates, awards, and deployment-quality classroom behavior.
The request includes external provider automation and content visibility decisions that cannot be implemented safely as a single packet.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Vimeo upload permission and privacy defaults
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Run the One Time member-library/classroom current-state performance and visual audit before UI implementation.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time app feel fast and professional, support class-specific video/slideshow/worksheet materials, automate the safe Drive-to-Vimeo path, remove confusing classroom-code UX for logged-in users, and build a moderated public-comment/update/awards loop.
raw_quotes: the entire app is extremely laggy
make sure there's proper filters so they can see what's the newest one that's uploaded
drop it into a drive folder and it will automatically go into Vimeo
students are going to be able to see the slides themselves and play the slideshow
we don't really want people to just take our AI videos
worksheets that are applicable to that specific class
we don't really need that classroom code to join the classroom
any response ... will show up on their own personal portal and it will just be pending
a live published comment gets pushed to the other students portal
updates section for the students portal ... scoreboard ... awards and progress

decisions_captured.decision: Drive-to-Vimeo real upload automation is blocked until target folder, Vimeo upload permissions, privacy defaults, duplicate policy, rollback, and explicit upload approval are confirmed.
Recommended default is member-only view-only slides/PDF/image decks, not public editable PowerPoint downloads.

out_of_scope: No real Drive write, Vimeo upload, Vimeo privacy mutation, email/WhatsApp/Telegram send, payment/access grant, or public publish in the first performance/audit packet.
No promise that browser media can fully prevent screenshots, screen recording, or determined capture.
No unreviewed student comment, private reply, or raw child text becomes public/member-visible automatically.
No BNA Academy media or classroom records may bleed into the One Time workspace.

inspection_targets: server.js One Time classroom/member-library payload builders
live One Time member/classroom route performance
observed: Member library has filters for All, Recently Added, Continue Watching, Masechta, Perek, Review, and Completed.
Member library currently renders Vimeo iframes directly in each card and re-renders the grid on filter/progress interactions.
Classroom/member-library use access codes as the current lightweight access token.
Classroom comments are already private/pending by default, but the full publish/reply/update cycle is not complete.
known_blockers: Drive-to-Vimeo automation requires explicit external-write approval.
Slides public/download policy requires owner decision.
Full app-wide lag may require a separate Operations performance packet after One Time surfaces are measured.

expanded_phrases.extremely laggy: Measure route load, interaction latency, DOM/media count, network errors, and main-thread work; fix the highest-confidence local cause first.
expanded_phrases.proper filters: Library filtering must support newest uploaded/published, continue watching, completed, Masechta, Perek, worksheets/assets, and review materials without cramped mobile UI.
expanded_phrases.automatically go into Vimeo: Drive drop creates an internal intake/upload-intent first; real Vimeo upload is gated by approved target, credentials, privacy, duplicate, rollback, and smoke policy.
expanded_phrases.slideshow: Each class can expose approved view-only slides/deck material in the same class context as the video.
expanded_phrases.security audit: Document realistic anti-copy controls and residual risk; do not claim impossible DRM.
expanded_phrases.classroom code: For logged-in users, access should resolve from session/magic link and code entry should be fallback-only.
expanded_phrases.published live: Human-reviewed comments can become member-visible; replies re-enter moderation.
expanded_phrases.updates: Student portal has a positive update feed for published class/community events.
expanded_phrases.awards and progress: Scoreboard/award/progress events show positive achievements without private data or shame.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use BNA first-party One Time tables/APIs as the review and audit layer; external media providers remain gated targets.

requirements.statement: Diagnose and reduce One Time member-library/classroom lag.
requirements.expected_result: First implementation packet removes the worst measured click/render lag source.
acceptance_criteria: Fix does not weaken member access or tracking.
Focused smoke proves interactions are responsive enough for desktop and mobile.

requirements.expected_result: Members can quickly find newest, continue watching, completed, worksheets/materials, and Masechta/Perek items.
acceptance_criteria: Filters are clear on desktop and mobile.
Newest uploads/published items are a first-class view.
Filtering does not reinitialize heavy media players unnecessarily.

requirements.expected_result: Security guidance is honest and implementable.
acceptance_criteria: Private embeds/view-only slides/no raw downloads are recommended.
Residual risks and approval gates are named.

requirements.statement: Replace classroom-code primary UX with login/session access.
requirements.expected_result: Logged-in parents/students enter class/library directly; code entry is fallback-only.
acceptance_criteria: Primary copy no longer says users are joining by code.

criteria: Super-ramble is split into child packets.
External Drive/Vimeo upload work is blocked until explicit approval.
Current-state performance/visual audit is required before UI implementation.
First implementation packet is limited to One Time library/classroom performance and filters.
Security policy must be written before exposing slides/material downloads.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Open member library with valid access and wait for API.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Loading status is visible and readable.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Load timing and disabled button duration are measured.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Use an access state with no published items.
empty.expected_visible_message: No published library items match this view.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state is announced in the result area.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Empty state does not trap keyboard focus.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Open TEST member library with seeded items.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Library cards and filters have clear labels.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Media controls and filters are keyboard reachable.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: DOM/media count and click latency are measured.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply a filter/search combination with no matching item.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: No published library items match this view.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: No horizontal overflow in mobile toolbar.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Search/filter interactions stay below the latency budget.

error.how_to_enter_state: Use an invalid or expired access code.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error is visible near the access control.
error.accessibility_expectation: Error is readable and not color-only.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Wrong access does not show private media.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Try to enable Drive-to-Vimeo without approved target policy.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked state names owner and next action.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Blocked state is plain text and actionable.

preview_only.expected_visible_message: Review route uses TEST-only member-library data
preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Preview route uses same member-safe layout.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Classroom route performance and DOM count are measured.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Fetch member library payload for valid TEST access.
success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: API maps into labeled UI sections.

permission_denied.expected_visible_message: A valid access code is required

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open library on mobile and use filters.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Mobile filters are named and reachable.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Touch targets are at least 34px and text does not overlap.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile filter click latency and layout are measured.

findings.user_impact: The operator reports severe button-click lag and slow app interactions.
findings.expected_fix: Measure and remove the worst member-library/classroom interaction lag source before broader UI polish.

accessibility.baseline: WCAG 2.2 A/AA plus mobile reflow and responsive interaction latency expectations.
required_checks: no horizontal overflow from filter rails
media controls do not trap keyboard focus

data_requirements: member library item id/title/class date/published date
approved class assets grouped by class session

scope_rules: One Time member media and comments stay scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

External Drive/Vimeo writes require explicit approval and rollback.
forbidden_content: raw private student text in member-visible feeds
raw editable PowerPoint files by default

instructions: Record the first high-confidence performance hypothesis.
Reduce heavy media/player initialization and full-grid rerenders where measured.
Improve filter labels and newest/material views.
Keep progress tracking and access checks intact.
